summary: Frontend regression + bugfix verification. All 4 scenarios PASS. (1) Enter key on /new thesis-input fires POST /api/ai/generate/stream and strategy card with start-practice-btn renders within ~45s with no error banner. (2) Clicking header Connect opens AuthModal with the email form (auth-email, auth-password, auth-submit) AND the 'Connect Phantom / Solflare' button (auth-wallet-btn) visible at the same time, no tabs — confirmed by screenshot. (3) Clicking auth-wallet-btn triggers the wallet-adapter modal (.wallet-adapter-modal visible, 'You'll need a wallet on Solana to continue') — a wallet connection attempt is clearly initiated, not silent, not an email form. (4) Email login with trader1@loom.test / testpass123 succeeds — modal closes after submit.

issues: Console warning: 'Encountered two children with the same key, Prices' — non-unique React keys in a Prices list. Not blocking but should be fixed.

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: React duplicate-key warning for key 'Prices' logged on homepage render — find the list rendering 'Prices' entries and use a unique key.

AuthModal.walletSignIn relies on the string 'connect' being in the error message to decide to open the wallet-adapter modal; fragile heuristic. Consider checking for a WalletNotConnectedError / no wallet selected explicitly, or always calling setVisible(true) when no wallet is selected before signIn().
test_credentials: trader1@loom.test / testpass123 — works for email login
context_for_next_testing_agent: AuthModal is now single-view (no tabs). Email form + wallet button are visible together in both register and login modes. Wallet button opens wallet-adapter modal correctly in a browser without Phantom/Solflare. Enter-to-draft on /new still works. Email login flow confirmed working with trader1@loom.test/testpass123.
rca of the issue: Previously the wallet option was hidden behind a tab; now AuthModal renders the email form and the 'Connect Phantom / Solflare' button together with a divider. walletSignIn() calls signIn() from AuthContext — on error it falls back to setVisible(true) which opens the @solana/wallet-adapter-react-ui modal, which was observed to render the 'You'll need a wallet on Solana to continue' prompt as expected on a wallet-less test browser.
